missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Майор' stays in the nominative as the subject. 'Приказ' is the accusative object, and 'чёткий' agrees with it in the masculine accusative.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Майора' takes the genitive-like accusative form because майор is an animate masculine noun. 'Своего' agrees in that form, and 'солдаты' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Майора' is the genitive marking the owner of the office. 'Нашего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Майору' is the dative marking the recipient of the report. 'О ситуации' is the prepositional topic phrase.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after preposition. 'Майором' is the instrumental after 'с', marking the person spoken with. 'Утром' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Майоре' is the prepositional form after 'о', the topic of conversation. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a number. 'Майора' is the genitive singular required after 'три'. 'В части' gives the location of service.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Майоры' is the nominative plural subject of 'собрались'. 'На совещание' is the accusative goal phrase.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Майоров' takes the genitive-like accusative plural because the noun is animate. 'Всех' agrees in that form, and 'командир' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Nominative with instrumental predicate. 'Майор' is the nominative subject of 'стал'. 'Известным генералом' is the instrumental predicate naming his new rank.
